name: IronClaw
description: Runs a self-hosted, security-focused personal assistant in Rust with WASM-sandboxed tools, routines, persistent memory, and REPL, webhook, chat, and web channels.

skills.name: WASM Tool Sandbox
skills.description: Runs untrusted tools in isolated WebAssembly containers with capability-based permissions and an allowlist of approved HTTP hosts.

skills.name: Credential Protection
skills.description: Injects secrets at the host boundary so tools never see them, with leak detection and prompt-injection pattern filtering.

skills.name: Dynamic Tool Building
skills.description: Builds a new WASM tool from a plain-language description and loads tools, channels, and MCP servers without a restart.

skills.name: Routines And Heartbeats
skills.description: Runs background work on cron schedules, event triggers, and webhook handlers, plus a heartbeat for proactive monitoring tasks.

skills.name: Hybrid Memory Search
skills.description: Stores notes, logs, and identity files in a workspace filesystem and retrieves them with full-text plus vector search fused by RRF.
